sections.title: Acceptance
sections.content: By purchasing a ticket or registering for an event hosted by MK Events, you agree to these Terms & Conditions.

sections.title: Event Entry
sections.content: A valid ticket and government-approved identification may be required for entry. Tickets are non-transferable unless explicitly permitted by the organizer.

sections.title: Code of Conduct
sections.content: Participants are expected to behave respectfully. Any disruptive, abusive, or unlawful behavior may result in removal from the event without refund.

sections.title: Event Changes
sections.content: MK Events reserves the right to modify schedules, venues, speakers, or activities when necessary.

sections.title: Intellectual Property
sections.content: Event branding, logos, photographs, videos, and other materials remain the property of MK Events unless otherwise stated.

sections.title: Limitation of Liability
sections.content: MK Events shall not be liable for indirect losses arising from event cancellation, postponement, or circumstances beyond our reasonable control.
